title: Gedolim Back Draft Law
body: Rav Chaim Kanievsky and other gedolim of Degel HaTorah and Shas held intense consultations, ultimately instructing their MKs to advance the draft-law proposal, paving the way for Knesset deliberations.

title: Letters Reveal Torah Leadership
body: Rav Elazar Menachem Man Shach and Rav Aharon Leib Shteinman's letters show draft deferments for yeshivah students were conditional: only someone fully dedicated to Torah study may receive a deferment.

title: Rav Dov Landau's Warning
body: Rav Dov Landau declared at Yeshiva Ma’or HaTorah that Sephardic yeshiva bochurim are not required to enlist in the IDF, citing no agreement for such enlistment.
